subject: Helio Financial - urgent routing fallback and traffic steering approval
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@heliofin.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@heliofin.com
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: [Urgent] 503s + latency spike impacting lending flows in us-west2

Hi Rishi,

We started seeing a sharp uptick in 5xx errors and per-request latency across our lending API calls served out of us-west2 at ~08:35 PDT. Error rate jumped from ~0.4% to ~6.8% and p95 latency doubled to ~1.8s. Throughput for our peak queue also dropped ~30% while queue length grew — customers are timing out and finance ops is reporting a small but material revenue hit for the last hour.

We attached a couple of traffic/latency graphs. Our retries are amplifying load and we risk breaching the 99.9% availability commitment in our SLI. Can you confirm whether this looks like a region-side capacity/eviction issue or a model runtime degradation?

Immediate ask: can Redwood initiate a controlled cross-region canary (15-25% to us-east1) and/or enable the routing fallback policy for Helio to bypass us-west2? We need the traffic moved before 10:00 PDT if possible. I will escalate internally but we need a quick yes/no on the failover action.

Also requesting an executive contact — our CTO is watching this closely.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Platform Engineering, Helio Financial
(attached: helio-errors-20280422-graphs.png)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@heliofin.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Urgent] 503s + latency spike impacting lending flows in us-west2

Daniel — thanks for the data and the head's up. We see the same signal on our side (ingress queue growth + increased tail latencies) and are treating this as a P0 routing/escalation.

Immediate plan we can execute now:
- Initiate a controlled canary: shift 15% of Helio traffic from us-west2 -> us-east1 for 30 minutes and monitor errors/p95.
- If canary looks healthy, ramp to 50% over 20m and then full failover as needed.
- Apply prefix/KV cache warmup for pinned sessions when moving to us-east1 to minimize cold-starts.

Neha — can you assemble ops to run the canary and validate kernel/runtime metrics? Marissa/Hannah — requesting authorization to proceed with a cross-region partial drain (docs attached). We will publish a short customer-facing incident note.

Daniel — we will begin the canary at 09:40 PDT unless you instruct otherwise. I will be on the call and will escalate to execs if metrics do not stabilize.

-Rishi
SVP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
(attachment: cross-region-drain-playbook.pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Re: [Urgent] 503s + latency spike impacting lending flows in us-west2

On Sun, Apr 22, 2028 at 09:27, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Daniel — thanks for the data and the head's up. We see the same signal on our side...

Agree with the canary approach. Ops runbook steps (I will lead):
1) Create a target weight rule for Helio service in the routing layer -> us-east1 15% (rollback TTL 5m).
2) Enable request-level tracing for the canary cohort and tag requests with helio_canary=true.
3) Warm KV cache for top 10 prefixes Helio uses (script attached).
4) Watch these metrics: 5xx rate, p95 latency, queue length, kernel evictions, GPU util.
5) If p95 improves <30% and 5xx <= 0.5% for 15 minutes, proceed to 50%.

I'll spin up the canary infra and post the metric dashboard link in the ops channel. Scheduling a quick triage call at 09:35 PDT (10m) to confirm.

-Neha
Technical Ops Lead, Serving Runtime
(attachment: exec-approval-request.docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent approval needed for Helio cross-region partial drain

Hannah — tagging you for exec approval. This is an emergency cross-region partial drain for a top-20 customer (Helio). Rishi & Neha are recommending a 15% -> 50% ramp; risk is transient cache cold starts and a brief increase in retries.

Authorization needed:
- Approve immediate canary and emergency routing override for Helio (us-west2 -> us-east1).
- Approve up to $X credit for affected customer if we can't meet SLOs for the interrupted window.

I will notify Sales/SCS and coordinate the customer-facing note. We need a quick yes/no to proceed at 09:40.

-Marissa
VP, Customer Success

> Attachment: cross-region-drain-playbook.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent approval needed for Helio cross-region partial drain

Approved. Proceed with the canary now.

Couple of directives:
- Keep execs (CTO/SVP Product) updated every 15 minutes with a short one-line status.
- If the canary does not show a material reduction in 5xx within 10 minutes, stop and revert — do not escalate traffic further.
- Prepare a one-page incident brief for the CTO and the account team immediately after stabilization.

I'll make myself available for a quick sync at 10:15 PDT for an exec readout.

-Hannah
Chief Revenue Officer (acting)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@heliofin.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@heliofin.com
Date: Mon, 23 Apr 2028 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Resolved] 503s + latency spike impacting lending flows in us-west2

Rishi / team — thanks for the rapid response. The canary to us-east1 fixed the p95 and brought 5xx down to 0.3% after the 30m window. We observed a small uptick in cold-starts but no customer-visible errors after the ramp. Finance confirmed revenue impact kept below our internal threshold.

Can you share the post-mortem and any suggested long-term routing policy changes (prefer shorter TTLs for pinned KV, auto-warm on evictions)? We also will want a small credit per our SLA for the window — I expect Marissa/Sales to follow-up.

Appreciate the exec engagement. Please add me to the post-mortem distribution.

Daniel
Director of Platform Engineering, Helio Financial
(attachment: helio-errors-20280422-graphs.png)
